faq.answer: Factory unreinforced POM/PBT becomes brittle from cabin heat cycling and snaps under motor cable torque.

faq.question: Is dropping the headliner required?
faq.answer: No. Replacing only the lift arms is performed entirely through the open roof opening in under an hour.

faq.question: Do I need to desolder any audio wires?
faq.answer: No. The hinge is engineered with a slotted wire passthrough channel that eliminates desoldering completely.

faq.question: Why is SLS Nylon PA12 required instead of resin?
faq.answer: Resin becomes brittle and snaps under the torsional flexing of the headband. Nylon PA12 provides flex fatigue resistance.
